statement: At the conclusion of its meeting on 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28, the Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on 2026-10-21.
resolution: The FOMC policy statement released 2026-10-28 on federalreserve.gov sets a target range with an upper bound above 4.00 percent.
failure_condition: The FOMC policy statement released 2026-10-28 keeps the target range upper bound at 4.00 percent or lowers it.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-27, at the ESMO 2026 Congress (Presidential Symposium scheduled for 2026-10-24), Merck and Moderna report an overall-population recurrence-free survival hazard ratio of 0.65 or lower for intismeran autogene plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab alone in the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 melanoma trial.
resolution: A Merck or Moderna press release, the ESMO 2026 presentation, or a journal publication dated 2026-10-24 through 2026-10-27 states an INTerpath-001 recurrence-free survival hazard ratio of 0.65 or lower for the overall population.
failure_condition: The INTerpath-001 overall-population recurrence-free survival hazard ratio presented between 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-27 is above 0.65, or INTerpath-001 data are not presented in that period.
